goal: Fix the live SSWR1 bootstrap deadlock where a summoner queues a real customer whisper but the Master refuses H before the sender is trusted, so K never returns and the customer text never flushes. Add runtime-only H-established admission for summoner-to-Master relay data while preserving canonical Master reply ACLs and all customer-facing mutation semantics.
shared_resources: SummonScout whisper relay OnEvent wrapper chain
notes: Live evidence: Feltaxi sends [SSWR1] H to the configured Master and canonical [SSI INVITE/JOIN/SUMMON] reports arrive, but no customer WHISPER_IN relay appears. V1 requires wrTrustedSummoner(sender) before H can establish the relay relationship, creating a circular bootstrap dependency when fallback-router trust is absent/stale. The fix is a last-loaded runtime-only trust bridge: H establishes an in-memory peer; only I/IB/IC/E from that peer receive temporary compatibility admission to the canonical V1 handler. K/R/RB/RC are never bridge-authorised, so Master reply ACLs remain unchanged. No SendChatMessage, summon, payment, trade, invite or customer-mutation path is added by the bridge.
